title: Transpose optional parsing results
summary: Move between optional input and fallible output without conflating missing, invalid and zero values.

inputType.clue: Input type allowing either a borrowed string slice or no input

outputType.clue: Return type allowing successful absence, successful u32 or integer parsing failure

mapping.clue: Option method applying parsing only when text is present

integer.clue: Unsigned 32-bit target type rejecting negative inputs

transpose.clue: Method converting Option<Result<T, E>> into Result<Option<T>, E>

extract.clue: Method extracting the successful result in the known-valid absence assertion

failure.clue: Method testing whether optional parsing failed

flatten.clue: Method removing one level from a nested Option

equal.clue: Macro checking the flattened present-but-empty optional value

none.clue: Option variant representing absence after removing one nesting layer
